n1c42518eb9.headline: Melisron: revenues rose by 6% - 223 million shekels
n1c42518eb9.summary: Melisron, an income-generating real estate company, reported a 6% revenue increase to 223 million shekels, with NOI up 22% and FFO up 42.5%.
n1c42518eb9.why: Strong operational recovery post-pandemic signals improving real estate market conditions and investor returns in Israel.
